# ABO fixture photos

40 main product photos (256 px) from Amazon Berkeley Objects, https://amazon-berkeley-objects.s3.amazonaws.com/index.html,
© Amazon.com, licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Unmodified; `manifest.json` lists
each file's ASIN and product type. Used by `tests/unit/test_image_model.py` to check the image index's thresholds with the
real model.
